purpose: Single unified Release-backed PDF storage for the 6,384-cell matrix and whole-encyclopedia acquisition. Git/LFS is not a PDF storage layer.

storage_contract.source_failover: immediate next independent catalogued source on restriction/failure
storage_contract.no_source_quota: the engine does not stop after a provider-specific book count

activation.write_scope: Release asset write access to the unified matrix storage repository

failure_policy: If a verified PDF cannot be persisted as a governed Release asset, the acquisition cycle fails closed. A second physical PDF copy is never created as a fallback; the book is retried from its catalogued sources.
